basic_info.description: Welcome to this wonderfully updated home in the highly desirable Bernal Heights neighborhood. With a beautiful 360-roofdeck view of the City, this stunning property features brand new interior and exterior designer paint, new roof, all new recessed lighting throughout, state-of-the-art fireplace, 8 skylights, elegant wine closet, stylishly remodeled bathrooms, and a spectacular modern kitchen with every convenience built in. Fall in love with the spacious backyard, beautifully designed and easily maintained with durable artificial grass, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. Neighborhood-wise, Bernal Heights proudly bears the influence of city sophistication, with trendy boutiques and innovative restaurants scattered among its homely storefronts. Whatever your lifestyle, this neighborhoods ideal location and distinctive community lets you create a life uniquely you, and this luxurious modern home will ensure that you and your family live the good life for years to come.
